text:
maria: Heads up — found partner webhook payload in a public gist that includes a wrapped ciphertext blob and what looks like a wrapped KMS header. Suspect creds exfil. Redacted the gist link in case it propagates.
incident-bot: DLP alert created: INC-2026-042. Files copied to secure incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-042/ (access restricted).
jordan: Copying in. Maria — can you paste the filename / object path and any indicators? we need scope.
maria: Found object path in partner-logs bucket: partner/webhooks/2026-03-21/payload.json. Inside payload there is a field `encrypted_blob` and meta header `vault-transit-key: transit-prod/partner-wrap`. Also saw a CI token pattern `ghp_***` in a few lines.
leo: If the wrap key is transit-prod/partner-wrap we should assume wrapping key material could be targeted. Immediate actions: 1) disable partner service account(s), 2) restrict bucket ACLs, 3) rotate wrapping key, 4) rewrap affected ciphertexts against new key, 5) rotate any CI tokens found.
ops-oncall: I'll disable the partner SA now and block egress for the associated IPs in the WAF.
ops-oncall: Done — partner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com disabled at 12:13 UTC. WAF rule 472 blocked historic IPs.
jordan: Maria/Leo — can you provide the minimal commands to rewrap and run an audit query so we can find other occurrences? Put commands here so oncall can run them.
maria: Audit query (Cloud Logging) to look for vault/transit unwrap calls:
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND protoPayload.methodName=\"vault.transit.unwrap\" AND timestamp>\"2026-03-20T00:00:00Z\"" --limit=1000 --project=redwood-prod
```
And a quick grep to find gist/clipboard leaks from backups:
```
gsutil cat gs://partner-logs/** | grep -i --line-number "ghp_\|gitlab-ci-token\|secret"
```
leo: Rewrap outline (Vault transit + Cloud KMS example):
```
# disable SA
gcloud iam service-accounts disable partner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

# export object, rewrap with KMS
gsutil cp gs://partner-logs/partner/webhooks/2026-03-21/payload.json /tmp/payload.json
./tools/crypto-rewrap --input /tmp/payload.json --old-key transit-prod/partner-wrap --new-key transit-prod/prod-locked-2026

# Vault transit rewrap (if using vault transit)
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@/tmp/payload.json destination_key=prod-locked-2026
```
ops-oncall: Running the find-and-rewrap script now. ETA ~25m. I'll also create a temporary deny binding limiting vault transit unwrap to service accounts in the `infra` group. Need Jordan or Security approval to apply RBAC change to prod-vault.

jordan: Approve the RBAC change. Make it a timeboxed deny binding for 6 hours while we rewrap. After rewrap we'll incrementally relax with audited rollouts.

incident-bot: Action items assigned: @ops-oncall (revoke SA + replace blobs), @leo (sweep & rewrap script), @maria (CI token rotation list), @jordan (RBAC approval + postmortem). Target SLA: 4h.
maria: I've started rotating the CI tokens behind feature flags. Will provide a list of rotated tokens and new secret locations. Also opened PR to add pre-commit scanning to the partner integration repo to catch gists: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/452

leo: Sweep script output (first pass): found 7 blobs referencing `partner-wrap` across partner-logs and backups. Kicking off rewrap jobs now. Will push logs to gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-042/rewrap-logs/

ops-oncall: Rewrap jobs started at 12:38 UTC. 3/7 done, no failures so far. Continuing.
jordan: Audit log forwarding — enable immediate export of Vault audit logs to the incident bucket and give security team read access. Use retention 90 days for the incident.
maria: Confirmed export enabled, security-team@redwood has read access on gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-042/.

ops-oncall: Rewrap complete at 12:59 UTC. Rotated wrapping key to transit-prod/prod-locked-2026. All 7 blobs rewrapped and checksum verified.
jordan: Good. Next: rotate any downstream secrets that could be derived from the exposed CI tokens. Maria — please coordinate with the app owners for partner integrations to rotate keys and publish a signed approval on the runbook.
maria: Will do. Also recommending we add an automated check in CI that fails PRs containing `gist.github.com` or `pastebin` links in `configs/` or `deploy/` dirs. PR forthcoming.

jordan: Postmortem owner? suggest Leo + Maria. Please capture timeline, root cause (partner leaked gist), remediation (RBAC tighten, rewrap, rotate tokens), and follow-ups (pre-commit scanning, partner contract clause requiring ephemeral keys).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> P2. Postmortem assigned to maria and leo. Target postmortem publish: 2026-03-26.

maria: Thanks all. Once postmortem is up we'll schedule a 30m retro with partner infra to align their secrets practices. :thumbsup:
